resources.string: This open-source engine does not include S.T.A.L.K.E.R. game data. Copy the files from a PC release you own, then select their directory below.

Stage 5 renderer bootstrap is complete: native Vulkan now owns a persistent frame loop. Stage 6 is in progress: the ShoC game module builds for both ARM ABIs and validates the selected installation, but menu, level loading and gameplay are not connected yet.
Android did not grant persistent access to this directory.
Select a readable game-data directory first.
